verdict.rationale: Jira is a work-tracking and project-management product, not an AI coding agent, so restoring an agent session to a previous checkpoint is outside its product category. The evidence shows only that Jira can hand work off to external coding agents and provides MCP/CLI context and an audit trail. None of that shows Jira itself runs agent sessions with a restorable version history.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can restore an AI coding agent's session to any previous checkpoint in its version history
